re :Thunderbird is stuck loading the same corrupted profile and always shows the welcome screen,

When I launch Thunderbird, the auto enabled Message Pane always displays the Welcome message. However, if disable it then it doesn't. How to disable:

  • Settings > General
  • Thunderbird start page:
  • uncheck : 'When Thunderbird launches, show the Start Page in the Message area'

Image would be appreciated showing the problem as maybe you have something different. What makes you believe it's a corrupted profile ?

If you created a new profile that points to the original profile then the original profile will open. It would be useful to see images of the following: In Thunderbird

  • Help > Troubleshooting Information
  • Application Basics - near the bottom of that section - click on 'about:profiles'

It shows all profiles. Make window as large as possible and post image showing contents of 'about:profiles'


re :%APPDATA%\Thunderbird\

Maybe you mean: C:Users/username/Appdata/Roaming/Thunderbird ? Access: C:Users/username/Appdata/Roaming/Thunderbird folder

Open 'profiles.ini' using Notepad Post an image showing all contents.
